title: Ad creative signaling Event Timeline record
description: One record on an MSF Event Timeline track whose eventType is urn:svta:advertising-wg:ad-creative-signaling. Encodes the two MUST requirements of draft-riedl-moq-ad-creative-signaling section 4: exactly one index reference field, and a data member holding exactly one SVTA 2053-1 Version 2 carriage envelope. Note the DASH and HLS bindings also accept bare Version 1 payload objects; this binding does not.

m.description: Media time index, in the coordinate space of the depends media track. RECOMMENDED for records describing creatives spliced into the media timeline.

t.description: Wallclock index. For placement opportunities defined in wallclock terms where no media time is available.

l.description: MOQT Location index, for records bound to a delivery position rather than a media time.
